subject: Fix critical bugs identified in codebase review
body:
Fix critical bugs identified in codebase review

- Fix inverted dispose logic in ProtocolBase (timer was never disposed)
- Fix EncryptedSecureString disposing static _machineKey shared by all instances
- Fix ProtocolFactory returning null for unknown protocols (now throws)
- Fix RandomGenerator creating new SecureRandom per call (use shared instance)
- Fix MySQL connection string injection (use MySqlConnectionStringBuilder)
- Fix bitwise AND instead of logical AND in PuttyBase wait loop
- Fix string concatenation in EncryptedSecureString key generation

Co-authored-by: Ryan Lence <lenceai@users.noreply.github.com>

security_flags.reason: credential and crypto paths need human review regardless of intent

triage.rationale: Most fixes already ours (MySQL builder, factory throw, Dispose logic, PuttyBase rewritten). Real gap: EncryptedSecureString disposes static _machineKey + string-concat key. Reimplement just that.

votes.concern: Four of six hunks target superseded code, risking conflicts or regressions in critical protocol paths.
votes.reason: Current HEAD has stronger MySQL, disposal, factory, and PuTTY fixes; reimplement only the EncryptedSecureString shared-key lifetime correction.

votes.concern: Reintroducing a blocking UI-thread busy-wait loop in PuttyBase and reverting modernized connection builder and disposal enhancements.
votes.reason: Our fork already solved these bugs cleanly with non-blocking async window searches, a secure connection builder, and proper disposal. Importing this would cause regressions.
